item.title: Arkansas Senate Candidate Running To 'Fight for Farmers' Backed Carbon Tax That Could Cost Them Hundreds of Millions of Dollars
item.description: Hallie Shoffner is running for Senate in Arkansas as a political outsider who will "fight for farmers." item.title: Jesse Jackson, Activist Who Threatened To Castrate Barack Obama, Dead at 84
